title: Describir a familiares
communication_goal: Describir familiares con edad, profesión, personalidad y acciones cotidianas básicas.
situation: Respondes preguntas sobre tu familia y comparas a dos personas.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.english: Her name is Elena. She is kind and funny.
dialogue.spanish: Se llama Elena. Es amable y divertida.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.english: She works as a teacher. She likes reading.
dialogue.spanish: Trabaja como profesora. Le gusta leer.

dialogue.speaker: Luis
dialogue.english: He is quiet, but he likes music.
dialogue.spanish: Es tranquilo, pero le gusta la música.

explanation_es: Para describir a un familiar usa he o she según la persona: He is quiet; She is kind. Para hablar de algo que le pertenece usa his o her: his job, her name. En presente simple, he/she lleva s en afirmativa: She works, He likes. Para preguntar por una actividad usa What does she do? y el verbo principal queda en base.
spanish_speaker_notes: Her name is... significa 'su nombre' cuando hablamos de una mujer.
No uses his para una mujer ni her para un hombre.
Después de does, el verbo no lleva s: What does she do?, no What does she does?.
Funny no es funny person en todos los casos; puede decirse She is funny.

pronunciation.tip_es: Practica cada descripción con el pronombre, el verbo y la información en tres grupos de ritmo.

reading.title: Elena and David
reading.text: Elena is Luis's sister. She is kind and funny, and she works as a teacher. She likes reading. Luis's brother David is quiet. He likes music and works in a store.
